title: MarketEvent - authoritative core record
description: One executed trade or quote from the authoritative core (ADR-001). Shape follows MRBS v1.1 section 2.1 record MarketEvent, made executable: integer ticks, three distinct clock domains, mandatory sequence, mandatory DataSourceId and version block.

eventType.description: Only core types. MBO events do NOT use this schema - see mbo_event.schema.json (ADR-002).

processingTimeUtc.description: When the recorder handled it. MRBS 2.1 requires all three to be distinguishable; equality is allowed, conflation is not.

exchangeLocalTime.description: MRBS 2.1 requires an exchange-local timestamp alongside UTC.

sequence.description: Vendor sequence where the surface carries one, otherwise a recorder-assigned monotonic counter. sequenceProvenance says which.

sequenceProvenance.description: Templates 150/151 carry no native sequence; MBO does. Recording which is which prevents a recorder counter being read later as an exchange sequence.

capabilitySnapshotId.description: MRBS DQ-003: every signal carries a CapabilitySnapshotId; missing means reject. Applied here at the record level so a downstream signal can always resolve the acquisition conditions it was built under.

vendorTemplateId.description: Rithmic template the record came from. 150 trade, 151 BBO, 156 aggregated book.

then.description: A trade must carry price, quantity and an aggressor with stated provenance.
If provenance is 'absent' the side MUST be Unknown - it cannot be quietly filled.
